culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Shirakawa-go has no bins: take rubbish home. No smoking outside designated areas; no fireworks, bonfires or camping. Use the designated toilets only.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Houses and fields are private and lived in: don't enter private property or fields, open doors, peek through windows or pick crops. Drone flying has separate village rules.
culture-and-protocol.note: Shirakawa-go only, from the village's manners and drone pages.

festivals.what: Takayama Festival: spring (Sanno) 14 and 15 April and autumn (Hachiman) 9 and 10 October each year, with floats, marionette shows and an evening float parade.

laws.rule: Climbers in the Northern Alps area (for example Nishihotaka-dake and Sugoroku-dake) and on Ontake-san, Yake-dake, Haku-san and Norikura-dake must lodge a climbing notification (tozan todoke) before climbing, under a prefectural ordinance: online through Compass, YAMAP or the Gifu Northern Alps council site, or on paper. Not lodging one, or lodging a false one, carries a penalty of JPY 50,000 (about A$451.18, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). A plan lodged with Nagano counts for the Northern Alps, Ontake and Yake-dake.

laws.rule: Gifu Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (岐阜県青少年健全育成条例), art. 28 (guardian) and 29 (others). The ordinance sets the late-night period as 10 pm to 4 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.

laws.rule: Takayama City: 高山市ポイ捨て等及び路上喫煙禁止条例 (Takayama Ordinance Banning Littering and Street Smoking), art. 9 and 10. Street smoking, heated tobacco included, is banned in designated zones that include the old town (Furui Machinami) area. A person who ignores a street warden's guidance and then the mayor's order (art. 11) is fined (過料, art. 14) up to JPY 10,000 (about A$90, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82); the city says it collects JPY 1,000 on the spot (about A$9.02). The zone map is a PDF on the city page.

Takayama City, whole city: littering (cigarette ends, cans, food scraps, gum, paper, bottles) in roads, walks, rivers, parks and plazas is banned (art. 7 of the same ordinance), dog owners may not leave droppings in public places (art. 8) and must carry a bag (art. 4). Visitors are covered by the ordinance's definition of citizens etc. (art. 2 item 6). Enforcement is by the same guidance, order and fine route (art. 11 to 14).
